defs.def: a firm promise that you will do sth or that sth will happen 保证；担保

ex.s: It guarantees the variety of food.
From then on, if I wanted to read an ending guaranteed to be happy, I’d pick up a love romance.
ex.t: 从那以后，如果我想读一个保证美满的结局，我就会拿起一本爱情浪漫小说。

ex.s: A simple greeting in their mother tongue can guarantee a smile from a total stranger and a tired traveller.
ex.t: 用他们的母语简单问候一句，就能让一个完全陌生的人和疲惫的旅客露出微笑。

ex.s: smile is no guarantee of quality service.
ex.t: 微笑不能保证服务质量。

ex.s: As many of us already know, having plans in place for the future is no guarantee that they will become reality.
ex.t: 正如我们许多人所知道的，为未来做好计划并不能保证这些计划会变成现实。

ex.s: Even though the owner of the company guarantees that the design will be in harmony with its beautiful surroundings, the local people are still concerned that the hotel may 6___________.
ex.t: 尽管公司业主保证设计与美丽的环境相协调，但当地人仍然担心酒店可能会___________。

ex.s: We guarantee that “From Shang to Qing: Chinese Art Through the Ages” will transport you to another time with its amazing collection of works.
ex.t: 我们保证"从商到清：历代中国艺术"将以其惊人的藏品带你穿越到另一个时代。

ex.s: SATISFACTION GUARANTEED (Adapted) Larry Belmont worked for a company that made robots.
ex.t: SATISFACTION GUARANTED (Adapted) Larry Belmont在一家制造机器人的公司工作.

ex.s: Our courses, totalling 20,000 hours of content in 20 different languages, guarantee you language skills you can use right away.
ex.t: 我们的课程总计2万小时内容，涵盖20种不同的语言，保证你掌握可立即使用的语言技能。

ex.s: REFLECTING dimension emerge exhibition guarantee investment purchase recognition representative visual 1 The first principle for any art collector is to only what you love.
ex.t: 反思 维度 涌现 展览 保证 投资 购买 认可 代表性 视觉 1 任何艺术收藏家的首要原则是只购买你真正喜爱的。

defs.def: a written promise given by a company that sth you buy will be replaced or repaired without payment if it goes wrong within a particular period 保修单；保用证书
something that makes sth else certain to happen 起保证作用的事物

ex.s: While Queensland Rail makes every effort to ensure trains run as scheduled，there can be no guarantee of connections between trains or between train services and bus services.
ex.t: 请在工作时间致电13 16 17失物招领处查询在昆士兰铁路服务中遗失的物品。

defs.def: money or sth valuable that you give or promise to a bank, for example, to make sure that you will do what you have promised 保证金；抵押品
a written promise to pay back money that sb else owes, or do sth that sb else promised to do, if they cannot do it themselves 担保书

ex.s: Buy with confidence: 21-day money back guarantee!

defs.def: to promise to do sth; to promise sth will happen 保证；担保；保障

ex.s: Scientific research is guaranteed by sufficient lab facilities.
ex.t: 充足的实验室设施保障了科学研究的开展。
数据安全措施得到保障。

defs.def: to give a written promise to replace or repair a product free if it goes wrong 出具保单（免费掉换或修理有问题的产品）
to make sth certain to happen 使必然发生；确保
to be certain that sth will happen 肯定 … 必然发生
to agree to be legally responsible for sth or for doing sth, especially for paying back money that sb else owes if they cannot pay it back themselves 承诺对 … 负法律责任；为 … 作担保
